Evidence to capture: Incident ID, control-review finding, audit note, customer issue, model evaluation result or cost/security signal
Owner question: Can reviewers trace the decision back to a real finding?
Green signal: Every row links to the source evidence
Stop/escalate signal: The remediation item has no source or severity context

Evidence to capture: Fix now, fix later, reject fix, accept risk, pause feature, rollback, restrict users or request adviser review
Green signal: Decision type is explicit and dated
Stop/escalate signal: The team says it is handled but cannot show the decision

Evidence to capture: Why the chosen action is proportionate, including customer, operational, security, privacy, safety and cost considerations
Owner question: Would a buyer understand why this was enough?
Green signal: Rationale names the risk and trade-off
Stop/escalate signal: Rationale is hidden in meeting notes or personal judgment

Evidence to capture: Business owner, technical owner, risk/security/data owner and date of approval or review
Owner question: Who is accountable for the residual risk?
Green signal: Named owner and review cadence exist
Stop/escalate signal: No one has authority to approve or pause expansion

Evidence to capture: Pull request, configuration change, prompt/version update, policy update, runbook change, ticket or operational control
Owner question: Can the team prove the remediation happened?
Green signal: Evidence link and implementation date are present

Evidence to capture: Regression test, replay test, human review sample, live-monitoring signal, cost check or incident recurrence window
Owner question: Did the fix reduce the risk without creating a new one?
Green signal: Retest result and monitoring owner are documented

Evidence to capture: Whether this decision changes go/no-go, cohort expansion, user permissions, customer messaging or vendor commitments
Owner question: Does this decision affect production expansion?
Green signal: Scale impact is linked to next approval gate
Stop/escalate signal: Expansion proceeds while open high-risk items remain unclear

Evidence to capture: What the company may and may not say externally about reliability, safety, savings, compliance or incident remediation
Owner question: Are public claims limited to verified evidence?
Stop/escalate signal: Team claims a fix, guarantee or compliance outcome not proven by evidence
